events.verdict: Avdija (POR) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects it away from Sengun (HOU) prior to incidental contact occurring during the imminent pass.
Sharpe (POR) reaches for the ball when arm and body contact occurs with Brooks (HOU), which dislodges him during the rebound.
Brooks (HOU) is assessed a technical foul.
Simons (POR) is assessed a technical foul.
Sengun (HOU) grabs Camara's (POR) jersey during his upward shooting motion before extending his arm into Camara's body after his release on the shot attempt.
Avdija (POR) reaches for the ball when marginal contact occurs with Sengun (HOU) as Thompson (HOU) retrieves the rebound.
Simons (POR) steps forward into Thompson's (HOU) path and marginal body contact occurs during his upward shooting motion.
Camara (POR) firms up over his left foot and establishes a screening position in Thompson's (HOU) path before absorbing the body contact during the pick.
Sengun (HOU) moves alongside Simons's (POR) path to the basket as he contests the driving shot attempt.
Avdija (POR) and Sengun (HOU) both engage and separate off-ball.
Avdija (POR) legally contests and makes clean contact with the ball prior to any incidental arm contact occurring with Sengun (HOU) during his post-shot attempt.
Camara (POR) establishes a screening position in VanVleet's (HOU) path and absorbs the contact to his front during the pick.
Smith Jr. (HOU) commits a take foul on Avdija (POR).
Camara (POR) moves laterally into VanVleet's (HOU) path and creates body contact that affects VanVleet's SQBR on the perimeter. The contact occurs before VanVleet's upward shooting motion.
Thompson (HOU) initiates contact to Sharpe's (POR) arm during his shot attempt.
VanVleet (HOU) pushes Camara (POR), dislodging him from his legally obtained defensive position.
VanVleet (HOU) is issued a technical foul and ejected for engaging in improper conduct directed toward the game officials.
